entities.summary: Otto, a notable figure in the history of Greece, associated with Nineteenth-Century Greece and the Megali Idea (1832–1863). Preceded by Othonian and Early Modern Greece. Their legacy influenced First modern Olympic Games held in Athens and Greece doubles territory in the Balkan Wars; Thessaloniki and Crete incorporated.
